clips.title: The story
paras: Archdruid Fandral Staghelm leads the druids of the Cenarion Circle from the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus. Stepping into power after Malfurion Stormrage vanished into the Emerald Dream, he championed the planting of the new World Tree, Teldrassil. Proud, abrasive, and relentlessly ambitious, Fandral advocates for an aggressive Kaldorei resurgence that frequently pits him against High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind.

Following the Third War and the sacrifice of Nordrassil atop Mount Hyjal, the night elves lost their immortality and their sacred sanctuary. When Malfurion Stormrage vanished, Fandral took up leadership of the druids and convinced the Circle of Ancients that it was time for their people to rebuild and regain their immortality. With the Circle's approval, he led the druids in raising Teldrassil off the coast of Kalimdor. He envisioned the colossal bough as a monument to Kaldorei endurance and a vessel to restore their lost supremacy, even though the Dragon Aspects pointedly withheld their blessings from the unapproved endeavor.

A millennium before the First War, Fandral served as the Kaldorei field commander in Silithus during the War of the Shifting Sands. Renowned among the insectoid qiraji as 'Kar'sis'—the Hand of Earth—he held the front lines alongside his beloved only son, Valstann. Exploiting Fandral's devotion, the qiraji General Rajaxx engineered a feint against Southwind Village and captured Valstann, ruthlessly executing him directly in front of the horrified Archdruid. The loss shattered Fandral's spirit, precipitating a devastating retreat and cementing an abiding, bitter hatred for the swarm that remains etched into his haughty demeanor.

Within the marble boughs of Darnassus, Fandral governs Kaldorei affairs with a haughty, unyielding hand. Unlike High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind, who favors spiritual preservation and cautious diplomacy, Fandral views military expansion and decisive strength as paramount to the survival of their people.
